description: Capabilities for Atlas's windows. Milestone 1's main window only needed core window chrome (minimize/maximize/close/resize). Milestone 2 adds the focus-companion window plus the permissions both windows need to create/show/hide/focus it from JS (see _lib/desktop/focus-companion-window.ts). Milestone 3 adds autostart:default for the Settings page's 'Launch Atlas when Windows starts' toggle (see _lib/desktop/autostart.ts) - the tray, global shortcut, and window-state persistence added in Milestone 3 are all native Rust (tray menu clicks, shortcut presses, window-state's own hooks), which the ACL system doesn't gate, so they need no capability entries here.
